# Germline findings

```{r germline_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

germline_pdf <- pcg_report$content$germline_classified
germline_vars_pdf <- germline_pdf$callset$variant_display
if (is.null(germline_vars_pdf)) germline_vars_pdf <- data.frame()
show_vus_pdf <- !isTRUE(as.logical(pcg_report$settings$conf$germline$ignore_vus))
max_vus_germline_pdf <- 20

clnsig_pdf <- if ("CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE" %in% colnames(germline_vars_pdf))
  germline_vars_pdf$CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE else character()
germline_plp_pdf <- germline_vars_pdf[
  clnsig_pdf %in% c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic"), , drop = FALSE]
germline_vus_pdf <- germline_vars_pdf[clnsig_pdf %in% "VUS", , drop = FALSE]

## virtual gene panel screened with CPSR
panel_pdf <- germline_pdf$panel_info
panel_desc_pdf <- if (is.null(panel_pdf$description)) "N/A" else
  panel_pdf$description
if (!is.null(panel_pdf$description_trait) &&
    !any(panel_pdf$panel_id %in% c("-1", "0"))) {
  panel_desc_pdf <- paste0(panel_desc_pdf, ": ", panel_pdf$description_trait)
}
panel_md_pdf <- if (!is.null(panel_pdf$url) && !any(panel_pdf$panel_id %in% "-1") &&
                    !grepl(",", panel_pdf$url)) {
  paste0("[", pcgrr:::doc_note_markdown(panel_desc_pdf), "](", panel_pdf$url, ")")
} else pcgrr:::doc_note_markdown(panel_desc_pdf)

has_control_depth_pdf <- "DP_CONTROL" %in% colnames(germline_vars_pdf) &&
  any(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(germline_vars_pdf$DP_CONTROL)) >= 0,
      na.rm = TRUE)
has_dual_moi_pdf <- "CPG_MOI" %in% colnames(germline_vars_pdf) &&
  any(grepl("/", germline_vars_pdf$CPG_MOI))
```

```{r germline_pdf_intro}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("Based on a germline variant analysis of the case with the [Cancer ",
    "Predisposition Sequencing Reporter (CPSR)](https://github.com/sigven/cpsr), ",
    "variants of clinical significance in cancer predisposition genes are ",
    "listed below - both novel (not recorded in ClinVar) and those with ",
    "existing classifications in ClinVar.\n\n",
    "- Virtual panel of cancer predisposition genes screened: ", panel_md_pdf, "\n",
    "- All variants classified as Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic are listed, ",
    "regardless of coding status\n",
    "- Variants of uncertain significance (VUS) are ",
    if (show_vus_pdf) paste0(
      "**also shown**, limited to a focused subset of protein-coding VUS ",
      "(at most ", max_vus_germline_pdf, ") - **not** the complete set of VUS ",
      "identified by CPSR") else "**not included**",
    "\n\n", sep = "")
if (has_dual_moi_pdf) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
    "For a subset of genes, *Inheritance* combines two modes (e.g. AD/AR): a ",
    "heterozygous finding typically reflects the dominant condition, while a ",
    "homozygous/biallelic finding may reflect a distinct, recessive condition."),
    title = "Mode of inheritance"))
}
if (has_control_depth_pdf) {
  cat("*Variants with a low sequencing depth (< 10X) are flagged in the ",
      "Genotype column - interpret their classification with caution.*\n\n",
      sep = "")
}
```

## Pathogenic and Likely Pathogenic variants

```{r germline_pdf_plp}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr NROW(germline_plp_pdf) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_germline(germline_plp_pdf, color = report_color)
```

```{r germline_pdf_plp_none}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(germline_plp_pdf) == 0
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
  "No pathogenic or likely pathogenic germline variants were found in the ",
  "virtual panel of cancer predisposition genes (CPSR).")))
```

```{r germline_pdf_vus_heading}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr show_vus_pdf
cat("## Variants of Uncertain Significance\n\n")
if (NROW(germline_vus_pdf) == 0) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
    "No protein-coding variants of uncertain significance were found in the ",
    "virtual panel of cancer predisposition genes (CPSR).")))
}
```

```{r germline_pdf_vus}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr show_vus_pdf && NROW(germline_vus_pdf) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_germline(
  utils::head(germline_vus_pdf, max_vus_germline_pdf), color = report_color)
```

```{r germline_pdf_vus_capped}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr show_vus_pdf && NROW(germline_vus_pdf) > max_vus_germline_pdf
cat("\n*Showing ", max_vus_germline_pdf, " of ", NROW(germline_vus_pdf),
    " variants of uncertain significance - the complete list is available ",
    "in the CPSR report.*\n\n", sep = "")
```
